entries.ro: Doamne, ai sărit peste cafeaua de dimineață?

entries.en: I ain't get paid to smalltalk. You lookin' for reliable iron, tha'ss what I sell. Ain't nothin' else worth wastin' breath on.
entries.ro: Nu sunt plătit să trăncănesc. Cauți fier de încredere? Ăsta vând. Restul nu merită să-ți pierzi gura pe el.

entries.en: Jeez, what bit you in the ass?
Hmm, dunno, maybe all them years with the NCPD? Or maybe it's the loan sharks nippin' at my balls. Or... Just MAYBE it's the whole fuckin' city other side o' that wall.
entries.ro: Hm, habar n-am, poate toți anii ăia la NCPD? Sau poate cămătarii care-mi stau la coaie. Sau... poate chiar tot orașul ăla nenorocit de dincolo de zid.
Greu de spus, pula mea, choom.

entries.en: Tsh, ain't a soul in Dogtown from Dogtown. The fuck that even mean "from here"?
entries.ro: Tsh, nu e nimeni în Dogtown din Dogtown. Ce pula mea înseamnă „de aici”?

entries.en: In the market for iron – any recommendations?
Yeah... buy whatcha want. Don't waste my time.
entries.ro: Da... cumpără ce vrei. Nu-mi irosi timpul.
